title: Food Bank of Eastern Oklahoma says fuel costs are taking meals away
summary_or_snippet: Food Bank of Eastern Oklahoma is facing record fuel costs while trying to expand summer meal delivery across 24 counties. Diesel spending is about $24,000 to $26,000 a month, up from about $12,000 to $14,000 in typical summer months, and the added fuel costs take meals away.
